content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is not a plugin or a third-party platform. It’s a self-owned commerce stack designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors refuse service. The core problem? Payment rejection. Stripe and PayPal operate in fewer than 50 countries. For creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, and beyond, this means no sales. COREMERCH solves this by eliminating middlemen. Your store runs on free, globally accessible tools: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. The customer pays in any of 300+ cryptocurrencies. You receive USD-equivalent at transaction time. No buyer account required. No KYC. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the beat is delivered automatically. You own the infrastructure. No one can shut it down.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the technical breakdown: Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally fast. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers (for Edge Commerce Stack) or Google Apps Script (for Sovereign Starter Stack). When a customer buys a beat, NOWPayments verifies the crypto payment on-chain. A webhook triggers the delivery script. The beat is pulled from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sent to the customer’s email or download link. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. All components are stateless and serverless. No server to manage. No database to secure. The stack is lightweight, fast, and designed for digital products. Fees are minimal: NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell beats, templates, fonts, presets, and other digital products. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, or any region where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure. No platform fees. No subscription traps. No data lock-in. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You control everything. This architecture is for creators who value sovereignty over convenience. It’s not the easiest path—but it’s the most secure. You’re not renting a store. You’re building a commerce system that no payment processor, government, or platform can shut down. This is infrastructure as a right, not a privilege.
Own your commerce stack. No platform can shut you down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but integrated. Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments: NOWPayments. Each component is chosen for its global accessibility and cost efficiency. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are free and fast. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase and Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all components, full source code, and a scaling playbook. Deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02 in 48 hours. Load your beats, set your prices, and go live. This is not a tutorial—it’s a deployable system.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). Download the blueprints, source code, and templates. Choose Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script) or Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers). Follow the step-by-step guide to deploy. Load your beats into the system. Set your prices in USD. NOWPayments converts crypto payments to USD at transaction time. Test end-to-end. Go live. The kit includes 30-day support for troubleshooting. Once deployed, the stack is yours. No ongoing fees. No platform dependence. Sell beats to anyone, anywhere. This is how you build a commerce system that can’t be blocked. This is sovereignty.

It includes blueprints, source code, and templates for hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. The kit supports GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, Google Sheets, and NOWPayments. Deploy in 48 hours. Sell beats globally with crypto payments. Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Choose Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script) or Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers). 3. Follow the blueprint to set up hosting and backend logic. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. 5. Load your beats into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test end-to-end delivery and payment processing. 7. Go live and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step blueprints and source code. No coding required. Deploy in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. After deployment, the stack is yours. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Only NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee.
Can customers pay in USD?
Customers pay in crypto. NOWPayments converts the payment to USD-equivalent at transaction time.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, the system retries. You retain full control to switch providers.
